description: The setup screen shows real loading progress for each step instead of using a fake timer
steps: Start the AI agent and the cloud browser at the same time so the user doesn't wait twice
List 'Connecting the AI agent' first since it finishes fastest, followed by 'Allocating cloud browser', 'Opening google.com', and 'Starting the live view' so steps check off from top to bottom
Check off each browser step only as the backend actually finishes it (session created, Google loaded, live view ready)
Only open the demo screen once all four steps are actually finished
If any step fails during setup, show the error right away with a 'Try again' button
